notes.title: Version 0.3.1: redesign of the menu interface and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The new version 0.3.1 is out, which means that it's time to talk about what's new:

1) Let's start with the most noticeable thing: the look of the menu has been changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/8561abb653cf4c3646248721bccd2fee3aade431.png[/img]

2) Corrected errors in the English translation. 

3) When connecting to the master server, the connection is now checked: if you cannot connect, you will be notified.

4) Now, when you try to connect to a full room, you will get a message about it. There will be no endless loading.

5) Notification when an incorrect password is entered. The password entry panel can now be closed.

6) Fixed endless loading when you select a character that has already been selected in the room.

7) The bug where a player could raise his character when not playing alone has been fixed.

8) The name you entered in the game is now remembered.

9) Other bug fixes.

I would also like to inform you that if you decide to kick a player from a room, his connection to the rooms will no longer work correctly, to fix this will need to restart the game. This will be fixed in future versions, so I recommend you don't use this feature yet.

I also want to announce my plans for the next version. I'm working on changing the interior of the first map. A lot of shelves will be removed, there will be more unique rooms. If you like the first version of the map, you still have time to run there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/d69cbc0835650c0b70de7afbfba04928ec289235.jpg[/img]

That's all, write your opinion in the comments. And what would you like to see in the game.

See you soon!

notes.title: News about the second map and the upcoming update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! There was no news for a long time. Well, it's time to share them! 

Work on the second map has already begun, now I will answer a few questions about the upcoming update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/71a2aa243f51b3189a87c65a481c316337f74678.jpg[/img]

1) When will the update with the new map be released?
If all goes according to plan, the update will be released in December.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/90f1fab7002b0f9086f0fccfd7af6be4d72e58d6.png[/img]

2) Will work on the first map continue?
Yes, some innovations will be added 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/033a10d98214e3f297aab2e1d06035c1921c75ca.jpg[/img]

I also saw a question about the number of players in the discussions.
Up to two players can play at the same time. The whole campaign was conceived precisely for this number of players.

Perhaps I will make a new campaign for up to four players after the game leaves early access, everything will depend on the interest of the community. But it's too early to talk about it. 

I also want to thank everyone who supports the game, writes positive reviews, you help the game develop and move on. 

See you soon!

notes.title: Version 0.1.5. Task List
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Version 0.1.5 was released, but 0.1.4 was also released yesterday, for which there was no announcement, so let's talk about the innovations of both versions. 

What's new:

Version 0.1.4: 

1) The probability of objects falling through the floor has been reduced to a minimum.
If this still happened to you, write to me about it.

2) The strange room now looks a little different.

3) As the objects became easier to see and an inscription appeared indicating which door the key is from, the balance shifted in favor of the player. So I increased the visibility range of the monster.

Version 0.1.5:

1) The names of items have a background. Now you can easily see the inscription in any light. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/c18c24b7902cf703b6cc66bdef6295148039cd42.png[/img]

2) A task list has been created that will show what needs to be done, as well as inform new players a little about the tasks assigned to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/ede9ddc694b4d3d515130548f78d069832e60e7e.png[/img]

3) Some bugs have been fixed.

That's all. Write in the comments what you would like to see in the game.

See you soon!

notes.title: Update 0.1.3. Effect for textures and display of item names
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I present to you version 0.1.3, let's talk about the innovations.

What's new: 

1) The keys and hammer have received an effect for the textures, now it will be easier to see them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/3c28aa3ced9ee280f14b283749918deab0301a3f.png[/img]

2) Now, when you look at the active item, its name will be displayed on the screen. 
In the next updates, I will most likely change the font and make the background for the inscription so that it is visible in any light. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/555c90cd2e72cebce431efcd80547662ddce9b3c.png[/img]

3) Some bugs have also been fixed. 

That's all, write your opinion about the update in the comments. And in the next version, I will try to significantly reduce the likelihood of objects falling through the floor. 

See you soon!

notes.title: Update 0.1.2. New parameter in settings, monster sounds, music in the menu
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Version 0.1.2 has been released and let's talk about the innovations. 

What's new:

1) A parameter has been added that is responsible for the smoothness of camera movement. It was initially non-configurable and the value was equal to five. Now you can customize it for yourself. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/5185941837ac503ec9f0fb23de180c235b9443c0.png[/img]

2) Now the monster makes sounds when patrolling, their volume depends on the distance at which it is located from you. This will help you navigate better and improve your gaming experience. 

3) The sound of rain, in the main menu, is replaced by music.

That's all, for today, write your opinion about the update in the comments.

See you soon!

notes.title: Update from version 0.0.9 to 0.1.0, answers to questions and some information
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that the game has been updated from version 0.0.9 to 0.1.0.

What's new:

1) Added audio settings. 
2) The description of the selected map (there is only one map at the moment) is now displayed in the players room, which will give a little information about what is happening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992199/c2bdc8f8680add8d5321b196e129f2ffc328f893.png[/img]

3) In the office, there will now be no problem with opening the table shelf in the middle. 
4) I added an inscription that it is not necessary to make a password for the room that you create (just in case)
5) And other small fixes.

Now I will answer some questions that the players have or may have:

1) Does the game support Mac OS? 

No, the game does not currently support Mac OS and will most likely be supported then the game leaves Early Access.

2) When will the main menu change? 

The appearance of the main menu will be completely redesigned in the future, while I plan to do this after the release of the third map.
But even before that, the appearance of the main menu may change, become more friendly.

3) When will the new map be released?

I will start working on the second map soon, and I plan to release it in November-December.

That's all, with the questions.

Maybe I'll add difficulty levels for the first map in the future. 
And also, I plan to redesign the lighting.

That's it, thank you all for your support and positive reviews.

See you soon!
